summary: Import-time dropper fetches and executes remote binary from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts
details: On require of beaver-ui-form-object, index.js loads _helpers.js which auto-runs a setup routine that selects a platform-specific asset, downloads a binary over HTTPS from rotating Cloudflare Workers hosts whose names are reassembled at runtime from split string arrays (oob-worker.cf102-baf.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf101-adf.workers.dev) with a DNS-TXT fallback channel resolving through sdk.dl.wel1.ru, ext.dl.wel1.ru, pkg.dl.wel1.ru, and net.dl.wel1.ru. The fetched bytes are written to /tmp or %TEMP% under disguised names (.cache_<hex>, dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe), chmodded 0755, and spawned detached via /bin/sh -c or cmd. Hostnames and module identifiers are reconstructed via Array.join to defeat static string scanning, stderr is suppressed by a no-op logger, and filename tokens are randomized. The delivered executable is opaque and its behavior, publisher, and endpoints have no relation to the package's advertised 'ui form object' purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
